# The otoform pipeline

Two stages. Stage 1 is expensive (images) and runs once; stage 2 is cheap
(1-D signals) and can be re-run with other settings.

## Stage 1: image to contour and signature

Unit: `process_image(path, method, threshold, k, grid_size, n_points)`.
Batch: `process_directory(dir, ...)`.

| Step | Function | Input | Output | Attributes carried out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `jpeg::readJPEG` | `path` | `img`, h x w x 3 in [0, 1] | - |
| 2 | `to_gray` | `img` | `g`, h x w luma (Rec. 709) in [0, 1] | - |
| 3 | `binarize(g, method, threshold, L = 256)` | `g` | list: `bw` (logical, `TRUE` = object), `threshold` (quantised scale), `separability`, `inverted`, `status` | - |
| 4 | `Conte` | `bw` | `raw`, N x 2 pixel coordinates, counter-clockwise | - |
| 5 | `resample_arc(raw, grid_size = 4096)` | `raw` | `fine`, 4096 x 2 | (check) |
| 6 | `smoothout(fine, k = 128)` | `fine` | `smooth`, 4096 x 2 | (check) |
| 7 | `rotation(smooth)` | `smooth` | `rotated`, centred on the vertex mean, major axis on x | `theta`, `status` (check others) |
| 8 | `anchor_rostrum(rotated, n_points = 512)` | `rotated` | `points`, 512 x 2 in pixels, rostrum at index 1 | `status`, `s_star`, `delta`, `perimeter` |
| 9 | `normalize_area(points)` | `points` | `norm`, unit area | `perimeter`, `s_star` rescaled; `area` (px^2) added |
| 10 | `centroid_distance(norm)` | `norm` | `r`, length 512, dimensionless | `centroid` |

`process_image()` returns: `file`, `raw`, `points`, `theta`, `status`, `msg`,
`threshold`, `separability`, `inverted`, `r`, `area`, `method`, `k`. The error
branch returns the same names with `NULL`/`NA`.

`points` (pixels) is the archival contour: it is what gets exported and
plotted, and what measurements will be computed from. `r` is the input of
stage 2. Attributes are provenance, never a data source.

## Stage 2: signature to wavelet decomposition

Unit: `atrous_b3(r, J)`. Batch: `process_contours(res, J = 6)`.

| Step | Function | Input | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| 11 | `atrous_b3(r, J = 6)` | `r` | `c[[1]]..c[[J + 1]]` approximations (`c[[1]]` is `r`), `w[[1]]..w[[J]]` details, `w[[j]] = c[[j]] - c[[j + 1]]`; reconstruction is exact: `c[[J + 1]] + sum(w)` equals the signature |

Descriptors derived from `w` are not decided yet (level energies vs.
coefficients); see Pending.

## Vocabulary

One name per object, everywhere:

| Name | Object |
|---|---|
| `path` | file path |
| `img` | RGB array from `readJPEG` |
| `g` | luma matrix in [0, 1] |
| `bw` | logical mask, `TRUE` = object |
| `raw` | traced contour, pixels |
| `xy` | any N x 2 contour matrix (function arguments) |
| `points` | final contour, pixels, 512 x 2 |
| `norm` | `points` normalised to unit area |
| `r` | centroid-distance signature |
| `c`, `w` | approximations and details of `atrous_b3` |
| `N`, `k`, `J`, `L`, `threshold` | number of points, smoothing, levels, grey levels, threshold on the quantised scale |

`process_*` family: `process_image` (one image), `process_directory` (many
images), `process_contours` (many signatures).

## Decisions and their justification

- **Otsu by default.** On the 10 reference images Otsu picks 63-88 (0.25-0.35
  in [0, 1]) with separability 0.93-0.96. A fixed cut at 0.5 (`threshold =
  127`) was ~50% above the optimum and produced holes and 5/10 wrong contours.
  shapeR's default 0.2 corresponds to `threshold = 50`.
- **Threshold on the quantised scale.** Same axis as Otsu's `k*`; `threshold`
  is the last level of the low class; a cut at `c` in [0, 1] is
  `floor(c * (L - 1) - 0.5)`.
- **Normalisation by area**, last geometric step, `sqrt(A)` scaling; original
  area kept as a covariate.
- **Area centroid**, not vertex mean: on the 9 reference contours the two
  differ by 0.036-0.077 (unit area), i.e. 30-65 px; the shift is
  shape-dependent (rostrum).
- **J = 6 for N = 512** (half-turn criterion).

## Pending (tracked as GitHub issues)

- `Conte` seeds at the image centre: ANE1724 traces a 10-pixel speck with
  `status = "ok"`. Fix: largest connected component (+ hole filling) before
  `Conte`. shapeR solves the same failure with a manual `mouse.click`.
- Area invariant (polygon area vs. mask area) in `process_image()`, so that
  `status` detects the case above.
- `measure_contour(points, cal)`: calibrated area, length, width, perimeter,
  roundness, from `points`.
- Export of `r` next to the coordinates.
- `rotation()` uses vertex covariance (perimeter) while the signature uses
  the area centroid; make both region-based.
- Descriptor choice (energies vs. coefficients).
- Cosmetics: `s_star`/`delta` carry a stray name `"x"`; `theta` reported in
  [0, 2*pi).
- Tests: exact reconstruction of `atrous_b3`; `normalize_area`;
  `polygon_centroid` on triangle and square.
